questions.question:
Directive Principles of State Policy are mentioned in which part of the Constitution? 
 राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व संविधान के किस भाग में दिए गए हैं?
questions.solution: DPSPs are in Part IV (Art 36–51), a very frequent SSC question.

questions.question:
Which of the following best describes DPSPs? 
 निम्न में से कौन सा नीति निदेशक तत्वों का सही वर्णन है?
options: Legally enforceable rights / न्यायालय में लागू अधिकार
Guidelines for State policy / राज्य नीति के लिए दिशानिर्देश
questions.answer: Guidelines for State policy / राज्य नीति के लिए दिशानिर्देश
questions.solution: DPSPs guide governance but are not enforceable.

questions.question:
DPSPs are inspired from which country's Constitution? 
 DPSP किस देश के संविधान से प्रेरित हैं?
questions.solution: Ireland is the direct source, commonly asked in SSC.

questions.question:
Which article states DPSPs are non-justiciable? 
 कौन सा अनुच्छेद DPSP को न्यायालय में लागू न होने वाला बताता है?
questions.solution: Art 37 clearly states DPSPs are not enforceable.

questions.question:
Equal pay for equal work is under which category of DPSP? 
 समान कार्य के लिए समान वेतन DPSP की किस श्रेणी में आता है?
questions.solution: Equal pay is a Socialist principle, very high-frequency PYQ.

questions.question:
Maternity relief is mentioned under which Article? 
 मातृत्व राहत किस अनुच्छेद में दी गई है?
questions.solution: Art 42 provides for maternity relief, important static fact.

questions.question:
Panchayati Raj is included in which DPSP category? 
 पंचायत राज DPSP की किस श्रेणी में आता है?
questions.solution: Village self-governance is Gandhian ideology.

questions.question:
Uniform Civil Code is provided under which Article? 
 समान नागरिक संहिता किस अनुच्छेद में है?
questions.solution: UCC is a Liberal principle and frequently asked.

questions.question:
Which DPSP promotes international peace? 
 कौन सा DPSP अंतरराष्ट्रीय शांति को बढ़ावा देता है?
questions.solution: Art 51 deals with international peace and security.

questions.question:
Which article deals with environmental protection? 
 पर्यावरण संरक्षण किस अनुच्छेद में है?
questions.solution: Added by 42nd Amendment, important trap question.

questions.question:
Which article deals with separation of judiciary from executive? 
 न्यायपालिका को कार्यपालिका से अलग करने का प्रावधान किस अनुच्छेद में है?
questions.solution: Separation of judiciary is Liberal principle.

questions.question:
Which DPSP appears in both Socialist and Gandhian categories? 
 कौन सा DPSP समाजवादी और गांधीवादी दोनों में आता है?
questions.solution: Art 47 includes health (Socialist) and prohibition (Gandhian).

questions.question:
Fundamental Duties are in which part? 
 मौलिक कर्तव्य किस भाग में हैं?
questions.solution: FDs are in Part IVA (Art 51A).

questions.question:
Fundamental Duties were added by which amendment? 
 मौलिक कर्तव्य किस संशोधन से जोड़े गए?
questions.solution: 1976 amendment, highly repeated fact.

questions.question:
Which committee recommended Fundamental Duties? 
 किस समिति ने मौलिक कर्तव्यों की सिफारिश की?
options: Balwant Rai Mehta / बलवंत राय मेहता
questions.solution: Swaran Singh Committee recommended FDs.

questions.question:
Total number of Fundamental Duties? 
 मौलिक कर्तव्यों की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
questions.solution: Initially 10, later 11 after 86th Amendment.

questions.question:
Which amendment added the 11th Fundamental Duty? 
 11वां मौलिक कर्तव्य किस संशोधन से जोड़ा गया?
questions.solution: Added duty of parents to provide education.

questions.question:
Which duty relates to environment protection? 
 पर्यावरण संरक्षण किस कर्तव्य से संबंधित है?
questions.solution: FD includes environmental protection, repeated PYQ.

questions.question:
Scientific temper is included in which part? 
 वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण किस भाग में है?
questions.solution: Scientific temper is a Fundamental Duty.

questions.question:
Which DPSP promotes cottage industries? 
 कौन सा DPSP कुटीर उद्योगों को बढ़ावा देता है?
questions.solution: Art 43 is Gandhian principle.

questions.question:
Which article ensures free legal aid? 
 मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता किस अनुच्छेद में है?
questions.solution: Legal aid is Socialist principle.

questions.question:
Which article deals with right to work? 
 काम का अधिकार किस अनुच्छेद में है?
questions.solution: Art 41 covers work, education, assistance.

questions.question:
Which DPSP protects monuments? 
 कौन सा DPSP स्मारकों की रक्षा करता है?
questions.solution: Important Liberal principle.

questions.question:
Which DPSP is related to prohibition? 
 मद्यनिषेध किस DPSP से जुड़ा है?
questions.solution: Gandhian principle, repeated trap.

questions.question:
DPSPs aim to establish what type of state? 
 DPSP का उद्देश्य किस प्रकार का राज्य बनाना है?
questions.solution: Core concept frequently asked.

questions.question:
Which case established balance between FR and DPSP? 
 किस मामले ने FR और DPSP के बीच संतुलन स्थापित किया?
questions.solution: Balance principle is key SSC concept.

questions.question:
Which case introduced Basic Structure Doctrine? 
 किस मामले ने मूल संरचना सिद्धांत दिया?
questions.solution: Very important constitutional case.

questions.question:
Which DPSP relates to early childhood education? 
 प्रारंभिक बाल शिक्षा किस DPSP से संबंधित है?
questions.solution: Modified by amendments, high-yield fact.

questions.question:
Which duty involves safeguarding public property? 
 सार्वजनिक संपत्ति की रक्षा किस कर्तव्य में है?
questions.solution: Commonly confused FD question.

questions.question:
Which of the following is NOT a DPSP feature? 
 निम्न में से कौन DPSP की विशेषता नहीं है?
options: Binding on citizens / नागरिकों पर बाध्यकारी
Guideline for state / राज्य के लिए मार्गदर्शन
questions.answer: Binding on citizens / नागरिकों पर बाध्यकारी
questions.solution: DPSPs are for State, not citizens.
